GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok landing on pace balanced up fourth fence 5 Lengths (1400m), Under Pressure 600, niggled before Turn , Straightened Up Under Whip just wacking away, lost Further Ground # spent b4 turn
Jumped well and Settled Down 5 3 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 5 Lengths turning, Lost Ground in str(Blinkers OFF AGAIN) # no excuses
Jumped well enough off the rails gate settled down right behind the leader fence 2 Lengths (1000m), Ridden Along into the Straight no closer & not likely to be, faded Further # fitter for that
Blundered on jumping & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 10 Lengths fence turning (leaders led 2.5 x 3), improved a couple of lengths in Straight # mostly Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Blundered at the start. Raced wide for the majority.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths Two Wide , shifted 3 Wide at 1100m and Moved Up to 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # Wide last 1100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide from the 1100m. Near the 350m laid in, bumped and became unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok wider out pushing on 4 & 5 deep out of the Straight 3 Wide third 1500 2 Lengths (1500m), Two Wide second Soon After , closer Turn , Straightened Up Quickly Under Pressure though winner swept by all, faded # Wide early no help

Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 6.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed it had been struck with a clod to the left eye and was treated on-course.] # never a factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to have been struck with a clod to the left eye and was treated on-course.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (5L from lead). Back 2 Lengths midrace until improving slowly 3 Wide from 700m. Pushed along Six Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 300m & ground home @ one pace in last 200m. # One-paced.

Jumped well no interest in leading settled down behind the leader fence 2-3 Lengths (1800m), urged along 600 leader quickened, Ridden Along Straight not running on, held Ground Without threat # one paced effort
Closed well to just miss here before an even showing at Eagle Farm. Suited back a notch in grade.
Jumped Ok Not Bustled from Outside Settled Down 5th Outside 6 Lengths within 5 Lengths x 800 Under Pressure @ 600m, kept trying without threatening had its chance - # Even Effort

Jumped well Wide out didn't want the front settled down one x one 2-3 Lengths (1800m), no change until 600 when left flat footed, wider for home now winding up, Under Whip late closing in couldn't quite get there # sound/kept coming
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vetted after having raced at Grafton on 30/9.
